image_description: Two light green baby bibs with a white daisy pattern are displayed outdoors on a bed of dry leaves and twigs, backed by green fern-like foliage. One bib is in the foreground, showing its full shape including the neck hole and rounded bottom. The second bib is partially visible behind the first, overlapping it slightly.
